test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 3, 6 and 4 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do thrice the same work, working together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM of 3, 6, and 4 = 12 units (Total Work)

Efficiencies: A = 12/3 = 4, B = 12/6 = 2, C = 12/4 = 3

Combined Efficiency (A + B + C) = 4 + 2 + 3 = 9 units/day

Thrice the work = 12 × 3 = 36 units

Time taken = 36 ÷ 9 = 4 days

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Time taken by A = 3 days, B = 6 days, C = 4 days.

Formula: Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

⇒ Total efficiency of A + B + C = 4 + 2 + 3 = 9 units/day

⇒ Standard Total Work = 12 units

⇒ New Work to be completed = 3 × 12 = 36 units

⇒ Time required = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency

⇒ Time required = 36 ÷ 9 = 4 days

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Efficiency

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time when work is constant. Efficiency = Work ÷ Time.

Combined Work Formula

If three people do work in x, y, and z days, the time taken together is (x × y × z) ÷ (xy + yz + zx).

Pipes and Cisterns

The concept of time and work is identical to pipes filling a tank, where efficiency represents the flow rate.
